How did the Hungarian revolution end?
back: A Russian army intervened, and the Hungarian army surrendered at Világos in August 1849.

front: Who crushed the Prague rising of June 1848?
back: General Windischgrätz, who bombarded the city.

front: Why did most of the 1848 revolutions fail?
back: Class and national divisions, loyal armies, peasants satisfied by the end of labour services, foreign intervention and the withdrawal of concessions.
